notes: Pull RT all the way down and keep it there. While you hold it the app switches who drives the controller, Driver then App, 12 times (every 3 s, about 40 s in all), and the check is that the virtual pad's RT never drops below 0.5 in that time: no hand-over may let the trigger go. Use it after any change to pad arbitration, pinning or the posting gate. It needs the background engine. Start it with the App path selected; the path is put back to the run's target when the hand-overs are done and to what it was before when the run ends. The result also says how many hand-overs the engine was seen following (armed live / inert). Added 2026-11-09 for the T7 driver check.

steps.detail: Only hold RT. Do not press or move anything else, and do not let go until the screen says "Let go now" (about 40 s). You have nothing else to do: the app itself switches who drives the controller, App and Driver in turn, 12 times while you hold.
steps.title: Pull RT all the way in and just hold it still

title: Hold RT while the app switches App ↔ Driver (T7)
